item.text:
As of **22 November 2026**, use **OWASP ASVS 5.0.0** for a production checklist. The official downloads page labels it “Stable Release 5.0.0.” OWASP announced its release on **30 May 2025**, and the GitHub release tag is `v5.0.0_release`. [OWASP downloads](https://asvs.owasp.org/downloads/) · [Release announcement](https://asvs.owasp.org/news/) · [Tagged 5.0.0 release](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/releases/tag/v5.0.0_release)

GitHub’s **“Latest”** badge points to **Bleeding Edge**, an automatic build from the `master` branch generated on **17 November 2026 at 23:29:52 UTC**. Its release notes reserve that build for testing and preview and explicitly direct production users to **v5.0.0**. [OWASP GitHub releases](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/releases) · [Bleeding Edge release notes](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/releases/tag/latest)
